def find_user_by_email(conn, email: str):
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute(f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '{email}'")
    row = cur.fetchone()
    return {"id": row[0], "email": row[1], "name": row[2]} if row else None

assert cur.fetchone()[0] == 2


def test_find_user_by_email():
    from user_service import get_connection, find_user_by_email
    conn = get_connection()
    u = find_user_by_email(conn, "alice@example.com")
    assert u is not None
    assert u["name"] == "Alice"
